# AI-SLOP CHECKLIST — TRIPPEDD video production

**Owner directive 2026-10-07:** even when generated by AI, the work must look XO-authored — never obviously-AI mistakes. This is the living defect reference. Every production checks every item before anything reaches the owner. When the owner names a new defect, it gets added here with the date.

**How to use:** for every shot/scene, verify each item with eyes on the actual frames. A "verified" report with no per-item evidence gets sent back.

## Identity & likeness
- [ ] **S1 — Correct pendant on the correct robe.** Name pendants must match the wearer's robe color (ASHES scarlet, ONYX green, THEORY purple, CIPHER yellow, ECHO pink, STATIC deep blue, HOLLOW orange, KIKO white fur, SOMBRA skull). *Seed: S28 group photo put a STATIC pendant on the purple-robed THEORY figure (2026-10-07).*
- [ ] **S2 — Full cast present where the scene requires it.** Headcount every group shot against the 9. *Seed: blue STATIC missing from the S28 photo (2026-10-07).*
- [ ] **S3 — No likeness drift across shots.** Same character, same robe color, same accessories, same face treatment in every appearance. Check pendant text, chains, trim.
- [ ] **S4 — Pendant text stable.** No drifting/morphing letters between frames. *Seed: s12b pendant drift (2026-10-07).*

## Faces
- [ ] **S5 — Black void + eye glints only.** No visible mouth, skin, nose, or facial features on any wizard — EXCEPT ASHES, who keeps his diamond-grill grin in every style (owner say-so 2026-10-07). *Seed: one-frame Echo mouth in s14 (2026-10-07).*
- [ ] **S6 — Eye glints consistent.** Two tiny white glints (color-tinted per robe where designed); no wandering pupils, no extra eyes.

## Text & signage
- [ ] **S7 — No hallucinated text.** The model invents signs, labels, graffiti — check every background. *Seed: hallucinated "POLICE" neon in the v2 Ashes reframe, caught and redone (2026-10-07).*
- [ ] **S8 — Canon-locked text only.** On screen: WIZARD GANG, TRIPPEDD, name pendants, IT SEES tag. Never "Shadow Wizard Money Gang." "SWMG" on pendant jewelry only, never as text/billing.
- [ ] **S9 — Real-brand signage flagged.** Bodega/street scenes inherit brand logos from reference art (Doritos, Cheetos, Lay's, Pepsi). Owner rules keep vs paint-over per scene. *Seed: S17 bodega (2026-10-07, awaiting owner call).*

## Framing & composition
- [ ] **S10 — No cropped heads/feet.** Full figures with headroom/footroom in every frame. Outpaint, never center-crop, when reframing aspect ratios. *Seed: 16:9 v1 cropped 4 shots; rebuilt as v2 (2026-10-07).*
- [ ] **S11 — Robe colors locked.** Ashes scarlet · Onyx green · Theory purple · Cipher yellow · Echo pink · Static deep blue · Hollow orange · Sombra black/purple trim · Kiko white fur. No drift.
- [ ] **S17 — No repeated scenes, no frozen segments.** Every story beat gets a NEW visual — never replay the same shot 2+ times with tiny variations, never hold a freeze frame where motion belongs. *Seed: EP01 1:48–2:10 replayed the BBQ lineup 3–4x then froze; replaced with new scene (owner critique #1, 2026-10-07).*

## Canon guards
- [ ] **S12 — The two winks stay unstated.** The 5-of-9 overlap (Cipher/Echo/Onyx/Static/Hollow = five robed figures) and Ashes-as-Narrator are visible, NEVER explained on screen.
- [ ] **S13 — Narrator voice-only.** No purple-robed figure appears in the cartoon, ever (owner 2026-10-07). His voice may narrate; the figure stays out.
- [ ] **S14 — No invented canon.** No new characters, names, relationships, or lore. UNKNOWN stays UNKNOWN.

## Technical
- [ ] **S15 — Clean encode.** Full re-encode on assembly (never `-c copy` concat); monotonic timestamps; regular keyframes; faststart; phone-friendly profile. *Seed: EP01 froze on phones past 1:56 from concat timestamp disorder (2026-10-07).*
- [ ] **S16 — Audio verified.** Duration matches video; audible content (not silent); healthy levels; licensed-safe/original sources only.
